data.name: VegetationCustomizer
data.shortDescription: Configure the density of bushes, plants and trees
data.description:
With this mod you can configure the density of bushes, trees and plants. Its works as if you had cut the vegetation by hand.

Due to technical limitations this only works if the LOD of the plants change (= if you move) and vegetation that despawns does also "pop" off suddenly. There is no way around that.

If it is despawned however, it will stay that way. Be warned: This is irreversible, so it will stay on save, even if you uninstall the mod.

This mod will increase the size of your savegame quite significantly because it does not only store the state of the despawned but also of the trees that should stay in the world.
